text:
maria: Heads-up — tomorrow 03:00-04:30 UTC we're running a controlled burst-capacity experiment + latency-guardrails validation. Purpose: verify per-route guardrails and the new burst pool autoscale behave under short spikes. Expect minor transient p99 increases for <=5m during roll phases.

devon: Will this touch production traffic? any canary only? :eyes:

maria: Yes production, staged canary. Traffic will shift to canary tier (5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100) with automated rollback windows. No user-facing feature changes.

tao: Which SLOs are we temporarily loosening? need the exact numbers for on-call runbooks.

maria: Adjusting the regional tail SLOs for the window: p99 latency SLO moves from 300ms -> 450ms for 30m at each rollout step. Error budget alert thresholds moved from 1% -> 2% for the experiment. All changes are tagged and auditable in the SLO service.

anika: Link to the experiment runbook? I want the abort checklist and how to cut traffic back to baseline quickly.

maria: Runbook + rollback playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-guardrails-burst-experiment (see section 2 for abort steps). Quick abort: `./ops shift-traffic --route all --to baseline` (takes ~30s to converge).

sre-bot: Automated checklist:
- 02:30 UTC: preflight healthchecks (kvcache warm)
- 02:40 UTC: capacity watcher hook enabled
- 02:50 UTC: canary pool prewarm complete
- 03:00 UTC: start 5% canary
- advance steps every 15m if metrics pass

devon: What metrics gate each step? CPU, p99, 5xx, queue-length?

maria: Primary gates: regional p99, region 5xx rate, request queue depth per worker. Secondary: GPU utilization and autoscale error rate. Gate thresholds are in the runbook. We'll promote only if p99 delta <= +80ms and 5xx delta <= 0.3%.

tao: Can we set a temporary tracing sample to 100% for the window? helps debugging.

maria: Yes — tracing bumped to 100% for %routes under experiment, will be turned back off automatically at 04:45 UTC.

anika: Any customer-facing comms needed?

maria: No. We expect no functional impact; only latency blips. Notify #support if you get paging noise.

ops-runner-bot: Scheduled job created: `burst-experiment-2790012345` -> runs 03:00 UTC, will post updates to this thread every step.

devon: I'll watch the dashboards and be on-call for the 03:00-05:00 window. ping me if we need to abort.

maria: Thanks — owners: @devon (on-call), @tao (metrics), @anika (rollback). I'll post a post-mortem summary in #eng-sre after the experiment with perf traces and suggested guardrail tuning. :thumbsup:
